evidence.observation: Sensor not installed; atmosphere/air-ingress cannot be verified during growth
Tube pressure drifting upward during growth: 2.97 -> 3.09 -> 3.13 -> 3.23 Torr while Ar flow steady at ~100 sccm
Brief overshoot to 760 °C at growth onset, then settled to setpoint; heater power rising slowly (39->45%)

args.missing_evidence: Exhaust O2 reading (or a leak-check/pump-down isolation test) to distinguish an air leak from exhaust restriction as the cause of the rising pressure
